description: FramePipeline.step on IMG_1710, cached model outputs from frame 60, every 2nd frame (30 fps), fresh state. landmarks are 33 x (pixel x, pixel y, visibility), null when no person was found. Candidates are (x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence) in full-frame pixels; full_candidates must only be used on frames where needs_full_frame is true.
